### Another application: understanding the role of schools in the rapid dissemination of pathogens {.unnumbered}

-   understanding the movement of children from their homes to school to activities can help to explain the role of schools in shaping the speed and frequency of future covid outbreaks.
-   this understanding can also help to guide control efforts that minimize the impact of intervention on learning (learning loss)
